audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly claimed Sejuani has no dash ('she has none', 'W dash-deny is wasted', 'immobile Sejuani') and called her gap-closer her E. Arctic Assault is her Q — a 650-range charge that knocks up and stops on the first champion hit, 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s.
audit.why: This inverts the single best interaction in the matchup: Steadfast Presence stops Arctic Assault outright, slowing and grounding her, and Hammer Shock's grounding zone denies it too. The advice told the user to stop holding W for exactly the thing it hard-counters.
audit.corrected: W (and Q grounding) named as the answer to Arctic Assault; Permafrost restated as an E that only stuns at max Frost stacks applied by Winter's Wrath (W), on a 1.5s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Permafrost was tracked as the punishable cooldown; at 1.5s it is never down.
audit.why: The real window is Frost stacks (applied by Winter's Wrath, 9/8/7/6/5s) and Arctic Assault at 18s rank 1.
audit.corrected: Cooldown text re-pointed at stacks and at Arctic Assault.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'her permafrost autos will stun you' — Permafrost is a cast ability on a stunned-condition target, not an auto-attack effect. Her passive shatter is the auto-attack piece.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Sejuani freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks', and the passive shatters a stunned enemy for massive magic damage.
audit.corrected: Described as W stacks Frost, E stuns at max stacks, passive shatters for a large chunk.

edits.before: Sejuani is immobile, and that is the whole lane for you — she has no way to dodge your E so you can reliably dash her into the wall for a stun and chunk her with max-HP Q. At Level 2-3 with Q+E online, walk her down whenever she steps up to last-hit near terrain. Watch her passive: if she has Frost Armor stacked her permafrost autos will stun you mid-trade, so burst her before her CC procs rather than auto-trading.
edits.after: Sejuani's only step-up is Arctic Assault (Q, 18s at rank 1), and W or a Q zone under her feet shuts the charge down cold — hold one for it. With Q+E online at 2-3, walk her down whenever she steps up to last-hit near terrain: E into the wall for the stun, then max-HP Q. Watch Frost stacks — Winter's Wrath applies them and Permafrost (E) stuns the moment they max out, so burst her before the stacks fill.

edits.before: Keep using E into walls to reset trades — her flat tank damage can't out-DPS your percent-HP Q, and she has no escape. At 6 your R is a hard answer to her engage: tap it to cancel her E gap-close or charge-launch her out before she can land her R AoE stun. Don't burn W expecting to block a dash — she has none — so save it as the armor/MR steroid for her E-W all-in.
edits.after: Keep using E into walls to reset trades — her flat tank damage can't out-DPS your percent-HP Q. At 6 your R is a hard answer to her engage: punt her out of an Arctic Assault charge, or launch her before Glacial Prison lands. Save W for that charge itself — stopping Arctic Assault slows and grounds her, and the armor/MR steroid carries you through the W-E follow-up.

edits.before: Late, both of you become utility frontlines and the solo-kill pressure dries up — your W dash-deny is dead weight against her kit, so the duel goes roughly even. Your edge is single-target disruption: R-launch her engage carrier or peel her off your backline before Glacial Prison chains your team. She out-teamfights you with AoE CC, so use your displacement to deny her the clean R every fight.
edits.after: Late, both of you become utility frontlines and the solo-kill pressure dries up — she engages on a 12s Arctic Assault and W answers it, so the duel goes roughly even. Your edge is single-target disruption: R-launch her engage or peel her off your backline before Glacial Prison chains your team. She out-teamfights you with AoE CC, so use your displacement to deny her the clean R every fight.

notes: Largest error on this page: Sejuani was described as having no dash. Arctic Assault (Q) is a 650-range charge and Poppy's W stops it outright — the exact interaction the text told the user to stop holding W for. Level chart is already correct and untouched. The page uses male pronouns for Sejuani throughout the full layer (tradeGood, ahead, feeding, dontsFull) — cosmetic, not corrected here to stay inside the length band on those strings. dosFull[2].t 'W his dash mid-flight' is 21 chars, under the applier's 25-char skip threshold, so the pronoun cannot be fixed via a proposal.
